correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the moments by conditioning on the reference v, rather than on u as in the frozen proof. Put z=1−q, b=x−m, V=||Pv||², W=||(I−P)v||², U=V+W, and X=v·x. Given v, u is Gaussian with mean ρv and covariance zI, also valid when z=0. Then G=m+u(u·b), E[u(u·b)|v]=qv(v·b)+zb, and E[||u||²(u·b)²|v]=q² U(v·b)²+qz[U||b||²+(d+4)(v·b)²]+z²(d+2)||b||², by expanding the standard centered Gaussian moments. For a unit x in one invariant subspace, put ε=1 on ran(P), 0 on ker(P). One has v·b=(1−V)X, m·v=VX, m·b=(ε−V)X², and ||b||²=1+(V−2ε)X². Average using independent χ²_k and χ²_(d−k) variables V,W, and conditional expectation of a squared coordinate equal to its block radius squared divided by rank (used only when that axis exists). Substituting these identities in an independently written integer-polynomial replay verifies both drifts and both printed second-moment polynomials coefficient by coefficient in d,k,q, rather than in a dimension grid. Orthogonal invariance preserving P forces block-scalar first and second moment forms and no mixed block. Nonnegativity of C_parallel−C_perp and the difference q in mean drifts make the parallel multiplier maximal, also at k=d where no other block is present. Expanding the scalar quadratic gives strict contraction exactly at the displayed subcritical q and positive h interval; a positive C_parallel gives the unique minimizer there. Freshness gives the conditional iteration bound. At the boundary the expected hinted projection is unchanged, and above it grows by (1−h[1−(k+1)q])^t; Jensen gives the stated nonconvergence/divergence for nonzero hinted initialization. The two-point noiseless differences on the specified quadratic are exact at every nonzero radius.
residual_risks: Contraction here means a uniform one-step expected squared-norm inequality. The theorem does not claim that every step above the subcritical interval gives asymptotic divergence, or that the worst-case one-step factor is the exact asymptotic rate.

The impossibility argument at and beyond the correlation boundary is stated for a nonzero hinted initial component. Nonlinear objectives, non-Gaussian law, measurement noise and time-correlated probes are outside scope.

value.rationale: Reusing a probe to save reference work is a natural algorithmic shortcut. A rank-only threshold that no choice of small positive step can fix beyond the boundary is a substantive limitation, not just an observation of bias. On the safe side the exact moments give a full minimax stepsize calibration, while the quadratic model isolates the reuse mechanism from curvature or measurement noise.
residual_risks: No claim against independent exploration or of practical performance improvement on general objectives.
